text:
Alan M: quick dump from canary 3 — p99 jumps after a chain of kernel swaps + KV stall. attaching short notes.
Ravi S: paste the numbers pls
Alan M: snapshot with identical traffic shape:
- microbatch=4  -> p50 8ms,  p95 14ms,  p99 19ms
- microbatch=8  -> p50 11ms, p95 24ms,  p99 58ms
- microbatch=12 -> p50 13ms, p95 34ms,  p99 128ms
Lina W: that p99 curve is non-linear. looks like one slow request inside the batch blocks others — amplification.
Nina J: what triggered the slow request? kernel path decision or memory page fault?
Alan M: profiler + flamegraph: choose_attention_impl -> calc_workspace -> malloc_fallback -> memcpy_pagefault (12-25ms). Also KV shard lock showed +40ms on the same host during the window.
Profiling-Bot: kernel_swap_count spike correlated with p99 window; samples show kernel_swap_count > 6/min on 3 hosts
Ravi S: brainstorming mitigations:
- lane sampling: probabilistically route high-risk requests to a small-batch lane
- kernel-sticky: keep a host pinned to latest kernel selection for short windows
- soft token budget: per-request soft max (percentile-based) with graceful truncation + reason tag
- prefetch_async: async KV prefetch for hot prefixes to reduce cold misses
Lina W: add a circuit: if host_kv_p95 > 60ms for 30s, move traffic off host and mark host degraded
Alan M: drafted config idea (YAML):
```yaml
runtime:
  lanes:
    default_batch: 10
    small_batch: 3
    sample_rate_small: 0.02   # 2% low-risk sampling
    high_risk_threshold: 0.45
    lane_cooldown_s: 90
  kernel:
    sticky_window_ms: 1000
    swap_hold_ms: 10
  tokens:
    soft_cap_pct: 0.85       # cap at 85% of requested tokens
    on_exceed: truncate_and_score
  kv:
    async_prefetch: true
    prefetch_depth: 4
    eviction_backoff_ms: 1300
``` 
Nina J: what's truncate_and_score do exactly?
Alan M: truncate_and_score will truncate output, return metadata {"truncated":true, "reason":"soft_runtime_cap"}, and emit quality_score_hint metric for Optimize to correlate. Also emit billing tag truncated_by_policy.
Ops-Billing: will add billing tag truncated_by_policy; want a separate metric billable_token_estimate when truncation happens
Ravi S: risk model proposal: combine (model_variant, seq_len_bucket, host_mem_pressure, recent_kernel_swap_rate) -> risk_score [0,1]. if > high_risk_threshold, route to small_batch lane.
Lina W: suggest we also implement token-shedding: if approximate output length > soft_cap, drop low-importance tokens (e.g., verbose filler) before truncating.
Alan M: interesting — token-shedding needs careful QA. for now keep soft cap + truncation, mark as opt-in per route.
Profiling-Bot: infra experiment queued 2003457000-probabilistic-smalllane; config: sample_rate_small 0.02; soft_cap_pct 0.85; probe-only 2h; will collect p50/p95/p99,kernel_swap_count,kv_miss_rate,truncated_by_policy
Ravi S: add sigtrap: capture kernel selection stack when kernel_swap_count > 3 in 1m window
Nina J: also capture the KV shard id and whether async_prefetch hit
Alan M: operation playbook snippets:
- rollout: probe-only 2h at 2%, then 10% enforce for 1h
- route circuit: if route_kv_p95 > 80ms for 45s, fallback to small model variant
- alerts: fast_path_rate < 0.9 -> paging
Lina W: metrics to emit: truncated_by_policy (bool tag), truncation_reason (string), risk_score_bucket (string), lane_assigned (string)
Ravi S: QA: run offline eval with truncated responses to ensure Optimize sees correct quality flags
Ops-Billing: remember to ensure truncated tokens don't double-charge customers; deduct estimated dropped tokens and expose in billing export
Alan M: action items:
- Lina: implement risk model + small_lane sampler (ETA 4d)
- Ravi: sigtrap + metrics hooks (ETA 1d)
- Nina: update circuit and rollback docs + SDK field for truncated responses (ETA 2d)
- Infra-Bot: run experiment and post raw flamegraphs and metrics here (scheduled)
Infra-Bot: experiment 2003457000 scheduled to start in 10m; will post results back to this thread
Alan M: thanks all — aim is to blunt p99 multiplicative spikes while preserving throughput. will paste experiment dumps and a short analysis after completion :thumbsup:
